name: Rosario Iera
bioAdditions: Rosario married Agostina (Faustina) Ferlaino on 26 February 1812 (S1). He was buried on 10 May 1874, aged 84, as the son of the late Giuseppe Iera and husband of Faustina Ferlaino (S2). His father's name, Giuseppe, is new.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Marriage and burial indexed; daughter Filippina's baptism names him.
